mechanism: Known tags marked with unknown VR retain their raw bytes rather than recovering the dictionary VR. The character-set consumer iterates those bytes as integers and passes73 to a regex, causing the saved TypeError during decode. Recovering the known short-value VR enables the expected conversion.
limitations: The charset regex detects a value-representation error originating in element construction. Undefined/large/unknown-tag rules are preserved separately; one upstream skip remains.

observed_failures.message: TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object
